newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three die after Russian tunnel collapses - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Three die after Russian tunnel collapses - Interfax.

text.p: At least three people were killed when a tunnel collapsed in the southern Russian region of North Ossetia, Interfax news agency said on Sunday.

Interfax, quoting the ministry for emergency situations, said one person had been rescued after the accident, which took place during building work. Rescue workers were searching for other building workers trapped under the rubble.
The agency gave no further details.
